method: Chromium + Three.js actual AnimationMixer and SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition, 65 evenly-spaced samples per clip, all 48 final crowd GLBs
limitations: LOD0 is a 210-triangle stylized human suitable for stands, not close-up photorealism.
LOD1 uses crossed ribbons on neck and legs; no duplicate coplanar faces were detected. Pixel inspection confirmed removal of the earlier z-fighting artifact.
LOD2 is a 24-triangle double-sided skinned silhouette and is intended for distant frontal stands; it becomes thin side-on.
Mouth and brow distances use anatomical proxies relative to the Head joint, not scanned facial landmarks.
Hand mesh proximity measures vertex-to-opposite-triangle distances. It does not prove continuous collision-free palm contact.
The floor and contact checks are sampled at 65 times per clip and are not continuous collision proofs.
Human appearance and emotion readability were reviewed visually; that assessment is subjective, separate from the numerical pass criteria.

visualReview.notes: Shorter visible neck, sloped shoulders, connected elbow/knee loops, closed pelvis, close scalp, and actual shoe volume improved human readability over the initial draft.
